entries.clue: Bright yellow security device bolted round a tyre and hub

Numbered list of items to be got through, circulated before anyone sits down

Blow-up bed that drifts out to sea if a dozing sunbather lets it

Once-a-year gathering of shareholders to hear the directors, in three letters
Steel A-frame at the nose, carrying the coupling and brake lever
Shelter design held up by two bendy poles crossing over at the top
Lidded vessel that boils water and rules the mid-morning social order
